text.card: A red giant 10,555 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.93 solar masses and 18.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,837 K at its surface.
